commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP 1: create appworker user =="
if id appworker >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "appworker already exists"
else
  sudo -n useradd -m -s /bin/bash appworker
  echo "created appworker"
fi
id appworker

echo "== STEP 2: configure limits =="
sudo -n tee /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf >/dev/null <<'EOF'
appworker soft nofile 8192
appworker hard nofile 8192
appworker soft nproc 256
appworker hard nproc 256
EOF
cat /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf

echo "== STEP 3: verify via login shell =="
sudo -n -i -u appworker ulimit -n
sudo -n -i -u appworker ulimit -u
echo "DONE"
commands.stdout:

appworker soft nproc 256
appworker hard nproc 256
== STEP 3: verify via login shell ==

256
DONE
